## Parcking Control (PC) - Prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing street parking in the whole city or per district (your choice).
## Features - Options menu dropdown: whole city, per district, or off. - Naturally, vehicles still use parking lots and buildings that allow parking.
## Good to know - It could take a few city months for already parked cars to move. If you want a faster reset of existing roads, try a vanilla accessory like updating to bike lanes on/off. - New roads in banned parking areas should be parking free. Caveat: a few cars may appear after a newly built road while the game updates parking lanes and paths (timing order). - If the city does not have enough parking facilities, the game handles the overflow normally to include use of outside-connection (hidden) storage/staging area. - uses the game’s own no-parking lane flag and does not delete vehicles or touch bicycles. - Safe to remove: streets return to vanilla parking.
## Support and Feedback - Consider clicking the like button (top right) to show support for mods. - Feedback and pull requests are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (right side icons). - Future plans: add UI for centralized parking fees - the current mod that does fees is asking for someone to take over the task.
## Credits River-mochi - mod author Maintyper - testing
### Why newly built roads can briefly receive cars - This is a normal minor timing/order: CS2 calculates a road’s parking lanes across several modification passes. - A car can claim a space during that process. - PC then sees the newly created or updated lane and applies ParkingDisabled. - It deliberately does not delete a car that already claimed the space so one could see a couple sneak in and choose to leave them or not.
